changes: Filtered history across all three paths the unit has lived at (63 commits). The current path alone holds 2 -- the same trap as hosts-blocker, and the reason the count was checked before filtering rather than after.

The six suites that test this code lived in linux_configuration/tests/, not beside it. They were filtered separately (24 commits) and merged as a second root, then their hardcoded periodic_background/digital_wellbeing/ prefixes rewritten for the new root-level layout. A path filter of the unit alone would have left them in the monorepo testing code that had left it.

Vendored linux_configuration/lib/common.sh into vendor/ rather than trimming it: set_actual_user_vars calls get_actual_user and get_actual_user_home, so a 4-function trim breaks silently. It went to vendor/ and not lib/ because test_music_parallelism.sh copies the unit's lib/ wholesale into a scratch worktree while stubbing the shared lib -- with both in one directory the real common.sh overwrote the stub and the test measured the wrong library.

Generalised that test's layout-drift guard from a required ../ prefix to (../)*; the script now sits at the repo root so the prefix is empty. The guard caught this move, which is what it was written for.

Dropped the two .pre-commit-config.yaml excludes for setup_midnight_shutdown.sh instead of moving them: lsattr shows nothing in the unit is chattr +i any more, and the fixer hooks leave the file untouched when allowed to run.
Removed --warn from the directory-depth-cap hook and reworded its comment from 'deliberately --warn for now' to state that re-adding it re-opens the hole.
